state.message: Keyboard focus disappears after I open the menu. Screen reader output also misses the selected item.
steps_to_reproduce: Navigate to the project menu with Tab
Press Enter to open the menu
Press Down to move to Rename
Press Escape; focus is no longer on the menu trigger
state.expected: Focus returns to the menu trigger and the selected option is announced.
state.observed: Keyboard focus jumps to the page body; the selected option has no accessible state.

impact.workaround: Reload the page and use the search command

related_reports.title: Menu selection missing from accessibility tree
Focus lost after closing a popover
